findings.evidence: Affine.lean:166-169 LHS `r • kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski f x`, RHS `kernelResidueFieldRingEquiv f r • kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski f x`; Affine.lean:112-117 is `@[simp]` with LHS exactly `kernelResidueFieldRingEquiv f r`. Contrast `Ideal.cotangentLocalizationEquiv_smul` (Localization.lean:102), where `@[simp]` is fine because the equiv is pushed through the scalar action.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` and keep it as a plain lemma (users rewrite with it explicitly when moving to the residue-field action).
findings.issue: `kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski_smul` is tagged `@[simp]` but is a transfer lemma, not a normal form: both sides are the same term with only the scalar changed, and the RHS scalar is strictly more complex. Worse, it compounds with the `@[simp]` `kernelResidueFieldRingEquiv_apply` (line 112), so simp turns every `r • kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski f x` (`r : k`) into `Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap H _ (algebraMap k H r)) • …`, destroying the `k`-linear structure any `finrank k` argument needs.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalRing/ResidueField/Basic.lean:50 `instance ResidueField.algebra {R₀} [CommRing R₀] [Algebra R₀ R] : Algebra R₀ (ResidueField R) := inferInstanceAs <| Algebra R₀ (_ ⧸ _)`; Affine.lean:79-86 install `Algebra k stalk` as `Algebra.restrictScalars k H _` with `IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl`, so `algebraMap k (ResidueField _) r` unfolds to the stated RHS.
findings.fix: State `kernelResidueFieldRingEquiv f r = algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (kernelPoint f))) r` (equivalently via `IsLocalRing.residue`), keeping `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `kernelResidueFieldRingEquiv_apply` characterizes the equivalence by `Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap H stalk (algebraMap k H r))` rather than by the canonical structure map `algebraMap k (ResidueField (stalk …)) r`. Mathlib registers `IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebra {R₀} [Algebra R₀ R] : Algebra R₀ (ResidueField R)`, so with the file's own `kernelStalkBaseAlgebra`/`kernelStalkIsScalarTower` the two are the same term; as stated the lemma does not tell a consumer that the equivalence *is* the `k`-algebra structure map, which is what makes it usable (bijectivity of `algebraMap k κ`).

findings.evidence: `grep -rn finrank TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/TangentSpace/Affine.lean TauCeti/RingTheory/Ideal/Cotangent/Localization.lean` → no hits. The repo already uses exactly this route at TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AbelianVariety/TangentSpace.lean:64-68 (`Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap`) and :172-178 (tower law).
findings.fix: Add `Module.finrank k (RingHom.ker (f : H →+* k)).Cotangent = Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (kernelPoint f))) (ZariskiCotangentSpace (Spec (CommRingCat.of H)) (kernelPoint f))`, proved from `(kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski f).finrank_eq` plus `Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap` (bijectivity of `algebraMap k κ` from the restated lemma above) and `Module.finrank_mul_finrank`.
findings.issue: No dimension comparison is exported. The PR states it delivers 'the augmentation-to-Zariski cotangent equivalence with its representative and dimension formulas' and targets the roadmap's dimension/smoothness tools, but neither new file mentions `finrank`; because the two sides carry different scalar fields (`k` vs `κ(kernelPoint f)`), `(kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski f).finrank_eq` alone does not give the comparison, and every consumer must redo the scalar transfer.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Hom.lean:471-472 `@[simp] theorem ofId_apply (r) : ofId R A r = algebraMap R A r`; Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Quotient/Operations.lean:389-391 `@[simp] theorem Quotient.algebraMap_eq (I) : algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) = Quotient.mk I`; Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Cotangent.lean:228-230 `mapCotangent_toCotangent … := rfl`, so the previous `algebraMap` statement was provable by `exact`.
findings.fix: State the RHS as `⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal x, …⟩` (or `algebraMap H (H ⧸ I.toIdeal) x`) and bridge in the proof — e.g. keep the previous `exact Ideal.mapCotangent_toCotangent …` (it is `rfl`-provable) or finish with `Subtype.ext (Algebra.ofId_apply ..)`; likewise restate line 94 with `algebraMap`.
findings.issue: The public `@[simp]` lemma `quotientCotangentMap_toCotangent` had its statement changed from `algebraMap H (H ⧸ I.toIdeal) x` to `Algebra.ofId H (H ⧸ I.toIdeal) x`. `Algebra.ofId_apply` and `Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq` are both `@[simp]`, so `Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal x` is the normal form; and because the term sits in the value slot of a `Subtype.mk`, simp cannot renormalize it, so consumers must reproduce the non-canonical spelling to match. Same non-normal spelling at line 94 in `augmentationIdeal_le_comap_quotient`.

summary: The comparison equivalence and its representative formulas are the right products, but three surface defects remain: a `@[simp]` scalar-transfer lemma that normalizes the ground-field action into an unusable residue-class form, a residue-field characterization stated in non-canonical terms instead of as `algebraMap k (ResidueField _)`, and no dimension corollary despite that being the roadmap product this PR advertises. A public `@[simp]` lemma in `HopfIdeal/Cotangent.lean` was also regressed to a non-simp-normal spelling.
